name: Rotary Helm Knob
summary: Helm control knob for autopilot, lights, anchor watch and music over Signal K
description: Turns the Elecrow CrowPanel 1.28" rotary display into a helm control: autopilot (heading, wind and route) with confirm turns, dimmer channels, an anchor watch with drop, move and raise, music volume and playback for signalk-jukebox, and a USB-HID mode for chartplotters. Night palette, idle dimming, settings on the knob and in the browser.
